note: Video-platform geometry plus the prompt templates for every deliverable. Ratio strings are platform-agnostic - pass them as text unless the target engine needs a specific token.

aspect_ratios.label: Vertical short
aspect_ratios.safe_area: keep the character's head inside the top 70% and leave the bottom 25% clear
aspect_ratios.use: TikTok, Reels, Shorts, Douyin, Kuaishou, WeChat Channels
aspect_ratios.tip: Never centre the face vertically - platform UI covers the lower third.

aspect_ratios.label: Landscape
aspect_ratios.safe_area: centre the character, keep key detail inside the inner 80%
aspect_ratios.tip: Place the character off-centre with negative space on the opposite side for text.

aspect_ratios.label: Square
aspect_ratios.safe_area: fully symmetric safe area with even margins
aspect_ratios.use: avatars, profile images, marketplace listings, feed cards
aspect_ratios.tip: The single most reusable ratio - design this one first.

aspect_ratios.label: Portrait feed
aspect_ratios.safe_area: like 9:16 but with more vertical breathing room
aspect_ratios.tip: Good default when the platform crops 9:16.

aspect_ratios.label: Classic portrait
aspect_ratios.safe_area: no platform UI overlap; keep 12% margin all round

aspect_ratios.label: Poster
aspect_ratios.safe_area: generous margin; keep the character's feet above the bottom 8%
aspect_ratios.tip: Use for merchandise and physical goods.

aspect_ratios.label: Ultrawide banner
aspect_ratios.safe_area: character occupies the left or right third; keep the centre clear
aspect_ratios.tip: Design for the character-plus-text layout, not a centred hero.

deliverables.purpose: The canonical reference image. Everything else is derived from this.
deliverables.template: {subject}, {role}, {signature_feature}, {proportion}, {silhouette}, {palette}, {material}, {outfit}, {expression}, {pose}, {signature_mark}. {style_core}, {medium_core}, {lighting}, on a plain softly lit background, {composition}. {quality}
deliverables.notes: Neutral front-facing pose, plain background, no props in hands. Generate this FIRST and use it as the visual reference for everything downstream.

deliverables.purpose: Verifies the character is recognisable with zero internal detail. Do this before generating anything else.
deliverables.template: {subject} rendered as a solid black silhouette on a plain white background, {silhouette}, {proportion}, {signature_feature} clearly readable in outline, no interior detail, no text, centred
deliverables.notes: If this fails, the design is not distinctive enough. Redesign before spending renders on it.

deliverables.purpose: Front, side and three-quarter views on one sheet, plus an optional back view.
deliverables.template: character turnaround model sheet of the same character, {subject} with {signature_feature}, {proportion}, {palette}, {material}, {outfit} identical in every view. Four separate full-body views in a row on a plain background: front view, left side profile view, three-quarter view, back view. Consistent scale, even spacing, flat neutral lighting, no perspective distortion, character design sheet, no text labels
deliverables.notes: Ask for 'the same character in every view' and 'consistent scale'. If views disagree, generate each view separately at 1:1 and composite manually - sheet generation is less reliable.

deliverables.purpose: The emotional range of the character on one sheet. Essential for reaction content.
deliverables.template: expression sheet of the same character, {subject} with {signature_feature}, {proportion}, {palette}, identical character design in every panel. {expression_grid}. Neutral front-facing head and shoulders in each panel, consistent lighting, plain background, no text
deliverables.notes: Describe the MOUTH shape per expression - it carries more emotion than the eyes. Use this sheet as the source for every reaction GIF in the series.

deliverables.purpose: A reusable set of body poses for animation and for still-image reuse.
deliverables.template: pose sheet of the same character, {subject} with {signature_feature}, {proportion}, {palette}, identical character design in every panel. {pose_grid}. Full body visible in every panel, consistent scale, plain background, even neutral lighting, no text
deliverables.notes: Add platform-specific poses here (hands forming a heart, shaka sign, phone-holding pose for live commerce).

deliverables.purpose: The character inside its world, for B-roll and establishing beats.
deliverables.template: {subject} with {signature_feature}, {proportion}, {palette}, {material}, {outfit}, {pose}. {style_core}, {medium_core}, {lighting}, {world}, environmental storytelling with foreground and background depth, {composition}. {quality}
deliverables.notes: Keep the character's locked descriptors byte-identical to the identity shot. Only world, pose and lighting change.

deliverables.purpose: A single looping frame designed for image-to-video. First and last frame must match.
deliverables.template: {subject} with {signature_feature}, {proportion}, {palette}, perfect looping animation setup, {loop_motion}, motion loop with identical start and end pose, subject fully contained in frame with even margin, plain uncluttered background, static camera, {lighting}, no parallax on the background
deliverables.notes: Static camera and a plain background are non-negotiable for a clean loop. If the engine needs first and last frames, generate them with the identical prompt and only change the pose to the loop extremes.

deliverables.purpose: Overlay-ready asset with cut border or transparent background.
deliverables.template: {subject} with {signature_feature}, {proportion}, {palette}, {expression}, {pose}, as a die-cut sticker with an even white cut border following the entire silhouette, glossy laminated print finish, centred, plain background, no shadow under the sticker
deliverables.notes: Also generate a transparent-background variant by adding 'isolated on a transparent background, no drop shadow'.

deliverables.purpose: Small-size identity mark. Must survive heavy downscaling.
deliverables.template: app icon of the same character, {subject} with {signature_feature}, head and shoulders only, {palette}, bold simple shapes, extremely high readability at small size, minimal detail, centred head icon, thick even outline, flat colour, plain solid background
deliverables.notes: Detail must be deleted, not shrunk. If it needs detail to read, the silhouette needs work.

deliverables.purpose: Wide header artwork with room for a channel name.
deliverables.template: wide channel banner artwork, {subject} with {signature_feature} positioned on the left third, full body visible, {palette}, {style_core}, {medium_core}, {world} suggested but soft, large clean empty space on the right two thirds for text, {lighting}. {quality}
deliverables.notes: Never render text into the banner. Add the channel name in your editor - generated text is unreliable and legally safer.

pose_grid_default: Six full-body poses in a 2x3 grid, each panel one pose: {list}

video_templates.image-to-video: {motion} for the character while the camera stays completely static, the character identity and the background remain completely unchanged, consistent lighting, no morphing, smooth continuous motion, natural timing
video_templates.text-to-video: {subject}. {style_core}, {medium_core}, {lighting}. {motion}. static locked-off camera, {ratio}, smooth continuous motion, no morphing, consistent character identity across the shot, consistent lighting from first frame to last
video_templates.camera: {subject} in frame. {camera_move}. {lens_note}. Consistent character identity, static lighting style, no morphing
